question: In Table 11, which study reports the highest conversion, and at what reaction temperature and methanol-to-oil ratio?
expect: Gaurav et al. (2013): 99.38% at 160 °C, 9:1, 3 wt% CaO on Al2O3 (Table 11, p9)
